title: Far loads and stores on non-65816 CPUs emit 65816 [dp] opcodes
summary: The p2:32:8 data layout applies to every MOS CPU, and the far runtime-address path does not check hasW65816(); selection does not enforce the HasW65816 predicate on LDIndirLong. A runtime far byte load compiles for mos6502 without error and emits $A7 $00, which the 6502 decodes as an undocumented LAX, the SPC700 as sbc a,[$0+x] and the HuC6280 as smb. Far global loads on those CPUs fail loudly; runtime loads and stores do not. Found by the independent review (finding B3) and reproduced on the downstream toolchain.

prior_work.source_assessment: Downstream MOSLegalizerInfo.cpp routes addrspace(2) runtime accesses to the long-indirect pseudos with no subtarget check; the extracted patch 4 tryFarIndirectAddressing likewise.
prior_work.binary_assessment: Downstream release llc 9031686c exits 0 for mos6502 and llvm-objdump shows a7 <unknown> at offset 0; the extracted candidate d7fde754 emits the same bytes for four CPUs.
prior_work.decision: The far-pointer design notes discuss keeping 6502 pointers 16-bit but no record, test or patch rejects far memory on non-65816 CPUs. New canonical record.

baseline.command: set -euo pipefail; build/far-review-defects/downstream/llc -mtriple=mos -mcpu=mos6502 -O2 -verify-machineinstrs -filetype=obj docs/defects/evidence/2026-09-30-far-access-non-65816/rt.ll -o build/far-review-defects/rt-6502.o; build/far-review-defects/downstream/llvm-objdump -d --mcpu=mos6502 build/far-review-defects/rt-6502.o | grep -E "^[[:space:]]+[0-9a-f]+:"; if build/far-review-defects/downstream/llvm-objdump -d --mcpu=mos6502 build/far-review-defects/rt-6502.o | grep -q -E "^[[:space:]]+0:[[:space:]]+a7"; then echo "MISCOMPILE: mos6502 far byte load emitted 65816 opcode \$A7"; exit 1; fi
baseline.working_directory: /home/will/llvm-mos-65816 (repository root). Captured in the wt/321-far-word-rebase worktree /home/will/llvm-mos-65816-nearproof, where build/far-review-defects/downstream holds hard links to the same frozen binaries.

configuration.expected: a diagnostic: far (addrspace 2) memory needs 65816 long addressing

baseline.failure_signature: MISCOMPILE: mos6502 far byte load emitted 65816 opcode $A7

resolution.change: patches/llvm-mos/0002-321-accum16.patch: MOSLegalizerInfo.cpp reports a DiagnosticInfoUnsupported ("far (address space 2) memory access requires 65816 long addressing; the target CPU has none") for every address-space-2 G_LOAD, G_SEXTLOAD, G_ZEXTLOAD, G_STORE and far G_MEMSET/G_MEMCPY/G_MEMMOVE when the subtarget lacks hasW65816(), instead of legalizing it to a long-indirect access.
resolution.causal_explanation: The far runtime-address path never checked hasW65816(), and selection did not enforce the HasW65816 predicate on LDIndirLong/STIndirLong, so mos6502 emitted $A7. The legalizer now rejects the access before any addressing-mode selection, so no long-addressing opcode can be produced on a CPU without it; far pointers passed as values are untouched.
resolution.trigger_check: The unchanged rt.ll runs through the candidate llc with the baseline configuration (mos6502, O2, -verify-machineinstrs, -filetype=obj); the runner passes only when llc fails with the diagnostic and emits no object.
regression_tests: llvm/test/CodeGen/MOS/far-access-non-65816.ll (in 0002): far load, store, extending load and memset diagnosed on mos6502, mos65c02 and mosspc700; a far pointer passed as a value still compiles on mos6502; the same accesses compile on mosw65816

resolution.validation: Full MOS CodeGen/MC lit suites on the candidate llc: 190 passed, 3 unsupported, 0 failed; the same suites with the baseline llc bind-mounted over build/llvm-mos/bin/llc fail exactly the four new tests (186 passed, 3 unsupported, 4 failed). Codegen of the same frontend IR for 277 SNES corpus and demo sources in plain mosw65816, +mos-a16 and +mos-a16,+mos-xy16 at -Os (831 source/mode pairs) is byte-identical between baseline and candidate llc wherever both compile; the 15 pairs that fail fail identically on both, and 12 pairs are frontend skips.
